'''Hangar Bay 631-D''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that was located in the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]. Circa [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the bay was occupied by a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] that was acquired by the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] student [[Dal Konur]], and Konur began preparing the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] for a mission that he planned to go on. However, he was confronted in the bay by a group of agents that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had sent to find him.
